title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
About the job

At Experis, the ManpowerGroup division specializing in IT projects, solutions, and professional technology talent, we connect top tech professionals with strategic initiatives across international markets, driving innovation and career growth through a people-centered approach.




🚀 We’re hiring: Paid Media Specialist 🚀

📍 CDMX | Hybrid | 

Are you a performance-driven Paid Media professional who knows Google Ads inside and out?

We’re looking for a Paid Media Specialist to join a global Marketing team within a B2B SaaS / technology environment. This is a highly hands-on role with real ownership of paid media execution, optimization, testing, and performance.

🎯 What you’ll own

• Manage, build, and optimize paid search and paid social campaigns

• Own Google Ads strategy, campaign structure, bidding, keywords, audiences, and budgets

• Manage and optimize significant paid media investment

• Monitor daily performance and identify optimization opportunities

• Build campaigns from scratch and run structured A/B tests

• Optimize landing pages, conversion paths, and post-click experiences

• Connect paid media performance to the full funnel: MQLs → SQLs → opportunities → pipeline → revenue

• Develop weekly/monthly performance reporting and actionable insights

• Partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Web, Content, and Revenue Operations teams




🔎 What we’re looking for




✅ Strong, hands-on expertise in Google Ads — this is a key requirement

✅ Proven experience managing campaigns and budgets end-to-end

✅ Experience managing significant paid media budgets

✅ B2B SaaS / Technology Marketing experience

✅ Demand Generation / Lead Generation experience

✅ Experience across Paid Search and Paid Social

✅ Strong analytical and performance optimization skills

✅ Experience with landing page optimization and conversion rate improvement

✅ Ability to translate data into business and revenue insights

✅ Advanced English — you’ll work in an international environment

✅ Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field

⭐ A strong plus:

🇨🇦 Previous experience working with Canadian markets or legal authorization to work in Canada.

💡 Who will thrive in this role?

Someone who is genuinely hands-on and can take ownership of campaigns rather than simply coordinate them.

If you can walk us through a Google Ads campaign you built from scratch, explain the budget you managed, the metrics you owned, the optimizations you made, and how those decisions impacted business results — we want to hear from you.

📍 Location: Mexico City

🏢 Work model: Hybrid

🌎 Environment: International

🗣️ English: Advanced

📩 Interested? Apply directly or send me your CV via DM.

#Hiring #PaidMedia #PaidMediaSpecialist #GoogleAds #PerformanceMarketing #B2BSaaS #SaaS #DemandGeneration #LeadGeneration #DigitalMarketing #MarketingJobs #TechJobs #CDMX #MexicoJobs

About the job

Senior SEO Specialist – Link Building & Digital PR

Department: Digital Marketing – Sales & Marketing

Reports to: Digital Growth & SEO Strategist

Location: Guadalajara, Mexico / Remote – TBD

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with Pacific Time business hours

Headcount: 1

About The Role

Farahi Law Firm is a California personal injury law firm competing in one of the most aggressive organic search markets in the country.

For us, authority is a major growth lever. This is a senior, hands-on SEO role focused specifically on link building, digital PR, and off-page authority. You will own our off-page SEO strategy end to end—from prospecting and outreach to securing high-quality editorial placements and measuring their impact.

You will work across both our English and Spanish properties, build authority around our priority practice areas and California markets, and mentor our existing Link Builder to raise the quality and effectiveness of our link acquisition efforts.

This is not a technical SEO role. Our in-house development team handles technical SEO implementation and site fixes. Your focus is building the authority that helps our content and pages compete.

What You'll Do

Link Acquisition & Digital PR


Own the off-page SEO roadmap, including target pages, anchor strategy, link velocity, and authority goals by practice area and city.
Personally prospect, pitch, negotiate, and secure high-quality editorial placements.
Build relationships with legal directories, local news outlets, community organizations, industry publications, universities, associations, and other relevant publishers.
Run digital PR and expert-source campaigns similar to HARO/Qwoted, positioning firm attorneys as credible sources for journalists and publishers.
Develop linkable assets in partnership with the content team, including original data studies, safety and claims research, local resource hubs, and statistics pages.
Create and optimize outreach sequences, pitch angles, and follow-up processes that generate repeatable placements.
Build and maintain a pipeline of publishers, journalists, editors, and other relevant contacts.


Local & Geographic Authority


Build citation and local authority for California service-area pages and Google Business Profiles.
Identify sponsorships, community events, partnerships, and local opportunities that can generate legitimate editorial links and brand mentions.
Coordinate with marketing, events, merchandise, and vendor teams to ensure sponsorships and partnerships translate into meaningful online visibility and links.
Identify opportunities to strengthen authority in priority California cities where competitors are outperforming us.


Quality Control & Risk Management


Establish and enforce a clear quality standard for every acquired placement.
Evaluate opportunities based on real traffic, editorial standards, topical relevance, domain quality, and long-term SEO value.
Avoid PBNs, link farms, manipulative link schemes, and placements that could put the domain at risk.
Conduct ongoing backlink audits and identify potentially toxic or spammy links.
Monitor competitor backlink profiles and turn link gaps into actionable prospecting opportunities.
Stay current on Google's link spam policies and evolving off-page SEO best practices.


Team Leadership & Reporting


Mentor and guide our existing Link Builder, including reviewing prospect lists, outreach quality, follow-up processes, and acquired placements.
Establish clear standards and expectations for link acquisition.
Report monthly on qualified links acquired, referring-domain growth, authority movement, and ranking impact.
Work closely with the SEO Content Lead, English and Spanish writers, and reporting team to ensure on-page and off-page strategies support the same priority pages.
Use data to evaluate what is working, what is not, and where we should invest additional effort.


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days


Complete a comprehensive backlink and competitor gap audit for our English and Spanish properties.
Deliver a prioritized 90-day link acquisition roadmap with named targets and page-level goals.
Establish and document a clear placement quality standard.


First 60 Days


Have an active outreach pipeline with a documented prospect list and tracked response rates.
Secure the first placements on priority pages.
Begin toxic-link identification and cleanup.


First 90 Days & Ongoing


Consistently meet an agreed monthly quota of qualified referring domains.
Demonstrate measurable authority growth across priority practice-area and city pages.
Drive ranking improvements across an agreed target keyword set.
Maintain zero placements that violate search engine guidelines.


Required Qualifications


5+ years of SEO experience, with at least 3 years specifically focused on link building, digital PR, or off-page SEO.
Demonstrated experience personally securing high-quality link placements.
A portfolio or track record of campaigns you can walk us through, including your outreach strategy and measurable outcomes.
Experience in a competitive commercial or YMYL vertical such as legal, medical, finance, insurance, or a comparable industry.
Excellent written English with strong persuasive communication skills. Outreach is a writing job before it is an SEO job.
Strong working knowledge of Ahrefs or Semrush, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics 4.
Experience with outreach and CRM platforms such as Pitchbox, BuzzStream, Hunter, Apollo, or similar tools.
Strong understanding of Google's link spam policies and off-page SEO risk.
Ability to work independently, own strategy, and execute hands-on.
Comfortable being measured on outcomes and communicating performance clearly.


Preferred Qualifications


Bilingual English/Spanish.
Experience marketing a personal injury law firm or other legal services business.
Existing relationships with journalists, editors, publishers, or relevant media contacts in the U.S.
Experience with local SEO, citation building, and multi-location Google Business Profile authority.
Experience developing and promoting original research or data-driven linkable assets.
Experience mentoring or managing junior SEO/link-building professionals.


What We Offer


A senior role with real ownership of a core SEO function, rather than a task-based position.
Direct collaboration with the Digital Growth & SEO Strategist and visibility with firm leadership.
Budget and support for outreach tools, digital PR, and linkable asset production.
An established content, design, and development team to execute against your strategy.
The opportunity to help shape the firm's organic growth strategy across English and Spanish markets.
Growth potential toward broader leadership within the organic search function.


How to Apply

Please Submit Your Resume Along With The Following


 Three link placements you personally secured


For each, briefly explain the placement, your outreach approach, and the impact it had.


 One campaign that did not work


Tell us what you tried, why you believe it failed, and what you changed afterward.


 Your SEO perspective


Where do you believe a California personal injury firm should be earning links that its competitors are not?

If you have personally built links that moved rankings in a competitive market, we want to hear from you.

• Account Management

💰 Salario competitivo + bonos por desempeño y revisiones periódicas.

Esta es una oportunidad para desarrollar tu perfil comercial dentro de una industria digital, aprender sobre Affiliate Marketing y trabajar diariamente con influencers y creadores de contenido de diferentes mercados.

It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. Because the CRO function is still young, your work won’t just impact conversion rates today. You’ll also help shape the experimentation methodology we can scale across 200+ clients.

title: Especialista de Marketing e Innovación de Servicios
description:
About the job

PERFIL DE PUESTO

Especialista en Marketing e Innovación de Servicios

Descripción funcional para selección, incorporación y evaluación del desempeño. El puesto integra la planeación

de marketing, la ejecución digital y la mejora de la experiencia del prospecto y del estudiante.




2 Objetivo general

Diseñar, implementar y evaluar estrategias de marketing orientadas al crecimiento y posicionamiento de CUH

Virtual, mediante el conocimiento de sus públicos, la gestión de campañas y comunidades digitales, el análisis de

resultados y la identificación de oportunidades de innovación que mejoren la experiencia del prospecto y del

estudiante.

Su actuación debe vincular la misión y visión institucionales con el diagnóstico del mercado, los objetivos, las

estrategias, las tácticas, la implementación y el control de resultados. La comunicación de la oferta debe

corresponder con el servicio que la institución puede entregar.




3 Perfil académico y experiencia

 Formación propuesta: licenciatura en Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Administración, Negocios Digitales o

áreas afines.

 Experiencia propuesta: experiencia en proyectos de marketing digital, campañas, contenidos y análisis de

resultados. No hay un mínimo de años de experiencia.

 Experiencia deseable en educación, servicios profesionales u otros servicios que requieran construir

confianza y acompañar una decisión de compra.

 Evidencias de selección: portafolio de campañas, contenidos e informes que permitan explicar el objetivo, la

contribución personal, los resultados y las mejoras aplicadas.




4 Conocimientos técnicos

La clasificación siguiente orienta la evaluación y perfil de candidatos. Los conocimientos indispensables son base

para las actividades a realizar; los importantes pueden fortalecerse durante la incorporación y los deseables

aportan especialización.

Indispensables

 Planeación de marketing: diagnóstico, segmentación, público objetivo, propuesta de valor, posicionamiento y

objetivos medibles.

 Comportamiento del consumidor: necesidades, motivaciones, barreras y proceso de decisión del prospecto.

 Gestión de redes sociales: calendario editorial, redacción, moderación, atención inicial y canalización de

consultas.

 Campañas digitales: objetivos, audiencias, presupuesto, anuncios, pruebas comparativas y seguimiento de

conversiones.

 Medición: interpretación de indicadores, hojas de cálculo y etapas del recorrido desde el primer contacto

hasta la inscripción.

 Comunicación institucional: ortografía, adaptación al público y tratamiento responsable de datos, testimonios

e información académica.

Importantes

 Marketing de servicios y experiencia del usuario: expectativas, calidad percibida y coherencia entre promesa

y entrega.

 Investigación de mercado, análisis competitivo, entrevistas y encuestas; integración de hallazgos en

decisiones de marketing.

 Gestión de relaciones con prospectos, segmentación de bases, seguimiento comercial y coordinación con el

equipo de Promoción y Difusión.

 Mapeo del recorrido del usuario y del proceso de servicio; identificación de fricciones, causas y

oportunidades de mejora.

 Analítica web, etiquetado de enlaces, páginas de destino y comunicación por correo electrónico.

Deseables

 Design Thinking, cocreación, prototipos y pilotos; SERVQUAL para analizar brechas de calidad y modelo

Kano para clasificar necesidades.

 SEO/SEM, automatización de comunicaciones, tableros de indicadores y producción audiovisual básica.

 Conocimiento del sector de educación superior en línea y uso de inteligencia artificial con revisión humana y

resguardo de información.




5 Competencias

Pensamiento estratégico y

analítico Relaciona acciones con objetivos; interpreta datos y justifica prioridades.

Orientación al usuario Escucha necesidades y propone soluciones que mejoran la experiencia.

Comunicación y criterio

institucional Redacta con claridad, verifica información y adapta el mensaje al público.

Planeación y ejecución Organiza entregables, presupuesto y plazos; informa desviaciones oportunamente.

Colaboración e iniciativa Coordina áreas, da seguimiento a acuerdos y prueba mejoras con evidencia.




6 Responsabilidades y actividades por eje

Eje 1 Estrategias de Marketing

Responsabilidad: traducir los objetivos institucionales en un plan de marketing sustentado en información del

mercado y de los públicos de CUH Virtual.

 Investigar necesidades, motivaciones, barreras y hábitos de los públicos; integrar información de consultas,

campañas, entrevistas y fuentes disponibles.

 Analizar competidores y alternativas de formación; identificar oportunidades y elaborar un diagnóstico de

fortalezas, oportunidades, debilidades y amenazas.

 Definir segmentos prioritarios y perfiles de público; formular propuestas de valor y mensajes diferenciados

por programa y etapa de decisión.

 Proponer objetivos medibles, estrategias, tácticas, calendario, recursos y presupuesto para revisión de la

Dirección.

 Coordinar la ejecución con las áreas involucradas y revisar resultados para ajustar prioridades, mensajes y

canales.

Entregables: diagnóstico de mercado, segmentos prioritarios, propuesta de valor, plan de marketing y reporte

periódico de resultados con acciones de mejora.

Eje 2 Marketing de Servicios

Responsabilidad: fortalecer la confianza en la oferta educativa y alinear las expectativas del usuario con la

experiencia real del servicio.

 Analizar cómo influyen la intangibilidad, la variabilidad y la interacción con las personas en la percepción del

servicio educativo.

 Revisar la oferta desde las variables del marketing de servicios: servicio, precio, canales, promoción,

personas, procesos y evidencias que generan confianza.

 Mapear los momentos de contacto del prospecto y del estudiante; detectar información confusa, demoras,

dudas recurrentes y diferencias entre lo comunicado y lo recibido.

 Convertir atributos verificados de la oferta en beneficios comprensibles; validar con las áreas responsables

los datos de programas, modalidades, costos y condiciones.

 Proponer contenidos, testimonios autorizados y materiales de orientación; recoger retroalimentación y dar

seguimiento a mejoras de comunicación y atención.

Entregables: mapa del recorrido del usuario, mensajes y materiales validados, diagnóstico de brechas de

experiencia y propuestas de mejora coordinadas con las áreas responsables.




Eje 3 Community Manager

Responsabilidad: administrar la presencia de CUH Virtual en sus comunidades digitales y mantener una

conversación oportuna, útil y consistente con la identidad institucional.

 Diseñar y mantener un calendario editorial alineado con los objetivos de marketing, las fechas académicas y

las necesidades de cada público.

 Redactar, adaptar y programar contenidos; preparar instrucciones para diseño y video, y revisar claridad,

accesibilidad y coherencia antes de publicar.

 Atender comentarios y mensajes en los horarios definidos; orientar consultas, registrar prospectos y canalizar

trámites o casos específicos al área competente.

 Aplicar criterios de moderación y escalamiento; identificar quejas o riesgos de reputación y comunicar los

casos que requieran respuesta institucional.

 Monitorear conversaciones y desempeño de contenidos; identificar preguntas frecuentes, temas relevantes y

oportunidades de participación de la comunidad.

Entregables: calendario editorial, contenidos publicados, registro de atención y canalización, reporte de

comunidad y alertas de reputación.

Eje 4 Campañas de Marketing

Responsabilidad: planear, ejecutar y optimizar campañas que generen prospectos pertinentes y contribuyan a la

inscripción, dentro del presupuesto autorizado.

 Definir para cada campaña el objetivo, público, oferta, mensajes, canales, calendario, presupuesto y criterios

de evaluación.

 Coordinar anuncios, formularios y páginas de destino; comprobar la consistencia de la información y el

funcionamiento del recorrido de contacto.

 Configurar la medición y el origen de los registros; verificar eventos, enlaces etiquetados y transferencia de

información al CRM o registro institucional.

 Ejecutar pruebas comparativas de anuncios, audiencias o páginas; analizar resultados y redistribuir recursos

dentro de los límites autorizados.

 Revisar con captación la calidad y el avance de los prospectos; detectar registros duplicados, problemas de

contacto o desajustes entre campaña y oferta.

 Presentar resultados con gasto, conversiones, aprendizajes y recomendaciones; distinguir resultados

atribuibles a campañas de resultados compartidos con otras áreas.

Entregables: ficha de campaña, presupuesto y calendario, piezas y páginas coordinadas, tablero de seguimiento

e informe de cierre con recomendaciones.




Eje 5 Innovación de Servicios

Responsabilidad: identificar, probar y evaluar mejoras del servicio a partir de necesidades de usuarios y

evidencia de los procesos institucionales.

 Recopilar hallazgos de entrevistas, encuestas, quejas, consultas y datos de uso; distinguir síntomas de

causas y formular problemas concretos.

 Mapear la experiencia visible para el usuario y los procesos internos que la sostienen; localizar fricciones en

información, contacto, inscripción y acompañamiento.

 Facilitar sesiones de ideación con las áreas responsables; priorizar oportunidades por beneficio para el

usuario, viabilidad, esfuerzo e impacto esperado.

 Diseñar prototipos o pilotos con hipótesis, alcance, responsables, recursos e indicadores; someter su

ejecución a la validación del área propietaria del proceso.

 Recoger resultados y retroalimentación; recomendar ajustar, ampliar o descartar la mejora y documentar lo

aprendido.

Entregables: cartera priorizada de oportunidades, mapas de experiencia y procesos, fichas de piloto e informe de

resultados y recomendaciones.

7 Herramientas deseables







Analítica y reports Looker Studio y Excel o Google Sheets.

Inteligencia Artificial ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Magnific

Contenido y producción Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud o equivalentes; edición básica de video y gestión de




recursos gráficos.

title: Customer Growth Specialist
skills: Own gross revenue retention and expansion for an assigned customer segment, with primary accountability for revenue retention and secondary responsibility for growth.
Identify recurring reasons why businesses in the cohort struggle or stall and develop scalable coaching approaches that address those challenges.
Design and deliver group coaching sessions, cohort programs, workshops, office hours, webinars, and asynchronous coaching experiences.
Advise customers on revenue-driving decisions such as pricing, packaging, positioning, offer design, email and funnel strategy, and retention mechanics.
Monitor customer data and cohort behavior to identify accounts showing signs of risk before they churn.
Analyze retention curves, funnel performance, and customer behavior to determine which coaching interventions are producing meaningful results.
Build repeatable playbooks, coaching formats, and processes that can become the foundation for scaling customer growth programs.
Share customer insights and recurring patterns with Product and Customer Success teams to help improve the broader customer experience.

The Customer Growth Specialist will own retention and expansion for an assigned segment of smaller video businesses.

You will be accountable for the revenue that stays within your customer cohort and the opportunities to grow it.

Habilidades y Experiencia Habilidades Core Fuertes habilidades analíticas y de resolución de problemas. Análisis de información cuantitativa y cualitativa: capacidad para conectar insights, data y tendencias con oportunidades claras de crecimiento. This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!

Labor and Material Pricing: Estimate shop fabrication and field installation hours, material quantities and yields, equipment requirements, and related project costs. Materials may include carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, glass, and specialty hardware.
Surface Finish Estimating: Calculate costs associated with galvanizing, powder coating, shop primer, painting, and other specialty finishes.

Bid Proposals and Scope Letters: Prepare competitive and comprehensive proposals, including scope inclusions, exclusions, clarifications, RFIs, alternates, and value-engineering recommendations for general contractors and project stakeholders.

Code and Standards Compliance: Ensure bid scopes reflect applicable California Building Code requirements, including egress and accessibility provisions under Chapter 11B, as well as relevant AISC standards and AWS D1.1/D1.2 welding requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate with detailing, purchasing, production management, quality, and field installation teams to compare historical production rates with current bid assumptions.
Vendor and Subcontractor Coordination: Solicit, review, compare, and negotiate quotations for materials, hardware, outsourced processing, specialty finishes, equipment, and subcontracted work.

Estimate Review and Handoff: Maintain complete estimate documentation and support project handoff meetings by clearly communicating assumptions, exclusions, risks, pricing, and production requirements.

Qualifications and RequirementsExperience: At least four years of proven estimating experience in structural steel, miscellaneous metals, ornamental iron, or custom architectural metalwork under United States construction standards.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on industry experience may also be considered.
Technical Proficiency: Advanced proficiency with digital takeoff software, preferably Bluebeam Revu, as well as Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pricing models, and cost databases.
CAD Knowledge: Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Inventor, or similar drafting and modeling software.
Codes and Standards: Strong working knowledge of the California Building Code, Title 24, AISC standards, and the cost and quality implications of AWS requirements.

Language: Advanced professional English, both written and spoken, is required for daily technical communication with project managers, general contractors, vendors, and other stakeholders in the United States.
Professional Skills: Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, commercial judgment, organization, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines and bid packages.
Preferred QualificationsExperience estimating both shop fabrication and field installation labor, equipment, and logistics.
Familiarity with cross-border operations, transportation, customs, and freight costs between Mexico and California.
Experience with model-based takeoffs or structural modeling software.
Knowledge of residential, multifamily, and commercial construction projects in California.
Experience developing value-engineering alternatives and identifying potential scope gaps or project risks.

title: Gerente de contabilidad
description:
About the job

🚀 Estamos buscando Gerente de Contabilidad




En The Coffee México buscamos a una persona que lidere nuestra operación contable y nos ayude a construir un área sólida, ordenada y preparada para seguir creciendo.




Responsabilidades principales:

• Liderar y garantizar el cierre contable mensual en tiempo y forma.

• Supervisar registros contables, conciliaciones bancarias, provisiones y depuraciones de cuentas.

• Asegurar la correcta integración de ingresos, costos, inventarios y gastos.

• Licenciatura en Contaduría Pública.

• Excel avanzado y experiencia trabajando con ERP.

• Deseable experiencia en retail, restaurantes, QSR, franquicias o empresas multiunidad.

El reto es muy claro: tener información financiera confiable, controles sólidos y cierres contables puntuales que permitan tomar mejores decisiones.

description:
About the job

About JC360

JC360 is an Azure-native Workforce Intelligence Platform that helps organizations understand how their workforce operates and identify opportunities to improve productivity, operational efficiency, compliance, and workforce visibility. Our platform provides organizations with data-driven insights into workforce activity, productivity, application and technology usage, and operational patterns - helping business leaders make better-informed decisions while reducing the administrative effort required to manage and understand a modern workforce.

JC360 is already used by organizations internationally, and we are now expanding our presence in the Mexican market.




About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Enterprise SaaS Sales Executive to develop and grow the JC360 business in Mexico. 

This is a consultative enterprise sales role. 

You will independently identify opportunities, build relationships with senior decision-makers, lead complex sales processes, and close enterprise customers.

Experience in workforce technology, analytics, employee monitoring, productivity, or related solutions is an advantage - but it is not a prerequisite.

Our priority is finding a commercially strong sales professional who knows how to sell complex B2B technology solutions and engage confidently with C-level and senior business executives.




A high level of autonomy

This role is designed for an experienced sales professional who knows how to generate results.

We do not prescribe a rigid sales process or measure success primarily by the number of calls made or hours spent online. You will have the freedom to decide:

Which industries and companies to target
Which decision-makers to approach
How to build and manage your pipeline
Which sales channels and strategies to use
How to combine outbound prospecting, networking, LinkedIn, partnerships, referrals, events, and other approaches
How to organize your time and prioritize activities that create the greatest commercial impact




Key Responsibilities

Your primary objective will be to create and close new enterprise business opportunities for JC360 in Mexico.

You will:

Identify organizations where JC360 can deliver measurable business value
Understand customer business challenges and identify relevant technology solutions
Engage with C-level executives and senior decision-makers across Operations, IT, HR, Digital Transformation, Business Transformation, and related functions
Lead consultative sales conversations, presentations, and product demonstrations
Develop and use the sales channels, partnerships, and tools you consider most effective




Requirements

Essential

4+ years of experience in B2B enterprise SaaS sales, business development, or a similar customer-facing commercial role
Proven track record of selling complex B2B technology solutions
Experience managing the full sales cycle - from prospecting and qualification through negotiation and closing
Strong ability to engage with C-level executives and senior decision-makers
Ability to understand complex customer requirements and translate them into relevant business solutions




Valuable Experience

Business intelligence and data analytics
Operational efficiency or business performance solutions
Other complex technology platforms addressing business or workforce challenges
Experience selling solutions to organizations with 500+ employees




Strong Advantages

Existing relationships with senior decision-makers in Operations, IT, HR, Business Transformation, Digital Transformation, or related functions
An established network within the Mexican enterprise business community
Experience developing new markets or territories with limited day-to-day supervision
Workforce intelligence, workforce analytics, employee monitoring, or productivity solutions




The Ideal Candidate

You are likely to thrive in this role if you:

Sell based on business challenges and outcomes - not simply product features
Have a strong track record in B2B or enterprise sales
Are comfortable selling complex SaaS or technology solutions
Can confidently engage with C-level executives
Are entrepreneurial and comfortable developing your own sales approach
Enjoy building new business rather than relying primarily on inbound leads




What We Offer

Freedom and Autonomy: decide how you approach the market, build your pipeline, and organize your sales activities.

Outcome-Focused Environment: we focus on commercial results and business impact rather than activity metrics such as hours online or number of calls.

Remote Flexibility: work remotely from Mexico and organize your working schedule around your sales approach.

Entrepreneurial Opportunity: play a key role in developing JC360's presence in the Mexican market and help shape our local sales strategy.

Global Technology: represent an international Workforce Intelligence platform serving organizations across different markets.

Performance-Based Earning Potential: competitive compensation with a strong performance-based component linked to successful business development and sales results.




Please ensure that your CV is available in English and clearly demonstrate your relevant enterprise sales experience, track record, and ability to meet the requirements of this position.




About JobCTRL

JobCTRL Ltd. is a Hungary-based software development company providing Workforce Intelligence and analytics solutions to enterprise customers across the globe.

description:
About the job

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) 

Hiring Manager: Matthew Sedlacek

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer with accounting and financial experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for leadership and innovation.

This position is ideal for professionals who began their careers in accounting or finance and later transitioned into software engineering — individuals who now want to leverage that domain expertise to architect and scale technical solutions that solve complex financial challenges in fintech.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.

Your role will extend beyond development. You’ll mentor engineers, shape technical direction, and bring a strong sense of ownership to every project you lead. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative, and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards, technical design, and regulatory best practices.

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.


Application submitted (you are here)
Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
Coding assessment (:1.5 hours)
Interview with recruiters (30 min)
Interview with engineers (1 hour)
Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
Offer!


What You'll Do: 


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
Participate fully in the software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.
Build new features and products as part of an integrated engineering team.
Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.
Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.

Build reports and automations using Python and SQL.

Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
Deliver high-quality, testable features that meet reporting and compliance standards.
Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge


What We Look For:


At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go and Java Python or a similar language.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.


Preferred Knowledge and Skills:


Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.
Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.
Experience in banking or financial institutions is a plus
Proficient in multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and experience with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications


About You: 


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
Version Control: Git
CI/CD: Gitlab
Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

You are an experienced Senior Functional QA Engineer who enjoys understanding complex business workflows and uncovering risks beyond standard happy-path scenarios. You bring a strong quality mindset to SaaS and enterprise environments, with the ability to understand how configurations, transactional processes, integrations, and downstream data flows interact across a broader ecosystem.




You are comfortable independently turning complex requirements into structured test strategies, executing detailed functional testing through web-based interfaces, and validating integration points and existing data-parity results. You bring strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and disciplined documentation practices, while collaborating effectively with platform administrators, business stakeholders, and technical teams.




Note: This is a temporary 6-month opportunity requiring consistent overlap with Pacific Time business hours.




You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is desired, or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of professional experience in Functional Quality Assurance, including hands-on testing of complex SaaS or enterprise applications.
Strong experience performing functional testing directly through web-based graphical interfaces.
Proven ability to independently create structured and comprehensive test plans covering business workflows, integrations, negative scenarios, boundary conditions, and edge cases.
Hands-on experience testing billing or subscription workflows, including subscription changes, mid-cycle modifications, invoice generation, and payment events.
Strong experience with functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
Hands-on REST API testing experience using Postman, Newman, or equivalent tools.
Read-level SQL knowledge, with the ability to interpret query results and data-parity reports to identify anomalies and discrepancies.
Ability to facilitate collaborative testing exercises with platform administrators and technical stakeholders.
Strong analytical thinking and the ability to identify non-obvious failure scenarios.
Detail-oriented documentation skills, including maintaining test cases, execution evidence, results, and defect logs.
Professional working proficiency in English.
Availability to collaborate during Pacific Time business hours. 




Nice to Have:

Hands-on experience with Zuora Billing, Revenue, or Subscription Management interfaces.
Experience participating in billing-platform migrations, ERP transitions, or comparable system-integration initiatives.
Familiarity with cloud data platforms or data warehouses, particularly GCP or BigQuery.
Experience using automated regression-testing frameworks such as Cypress or pytest.
ISTQB Foundation certification or an equivalent testing credential. 




You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

Create and maintain a comprehensive functional testing plan for SaaS billing and cloud-data integrations.
Design test scenarios covering billing configurations, subscription lifecycle workflows, invoice generation, payment processing, and revenue-related data flows.
Execute functional tests primarily through the platform’s graphical interfaces.
Validate configurations, business workflows, and integration touchpoints across standard, negative, boundary, and edge-case scenarios.
Coordinate testing exercises with platform administrators and technical stakeholders, ensuring clear responsibilities, coverage, and expected outcomes.
Validate REST API integration touchpoints using Postman, Newman, or equivalent tools.
Review existing data-parity reports and query results to identify anomalies and flag discrepancies for further investigation.
Document test cases, execution evidence, results, defects, and retesting outcomes to maintain a complete audit trail.
Collaborate with business and engineering stakeholders to align functional test coverage with business rules and integration behavior.
Communicate testing progress, risks, blockers, defects, and quality concerns clearly and proactively.
Perform regression testing and confirm that resolved defects do not negatively affect related billing or subscription workflows. 




Additional Information

About Us




We Are Engineered Different.




At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.




We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.




Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

Execution: Proven track record of managing a high volume of vendor assessments and maintaining a state of "audit-readiness" for bank partners and regulators.

Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

About the job

The salary range for this role is negotiable, the range being $5,000 - $6,500 USD gross per month. 

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Vendor Management Program Manager to lead the execution of our third-party risk management framework. This role is the backbone of our vendor oversight, ensuring that every partnership—from non-critical services to complex bank integrations—aligns with our high standards for security, compliance, and operational excellence. You will have the authority to manage the vendor lifecycle and ensure our program remains robust under regulatory scrutiny.

Compensation

The compensation range for the role is $5,000 - $6,500 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

What You'll Do:


Standards & Governance: work cross-functionally with IT, Legal, and Compliance teams to establish and maintain third-party risk standards and governance practices.
Due Diligence & Monitoring: Conduct comprehensive vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring activities, including evaluating consumer-impact risk, complaint analysis, and confirming privacy and data protection standards.
Documentation & Reporting: Manage third-party risk documentation and reporting, including maintaining the vendor and data processor inventory, ensuring timely onboarding and offboarding due diligence, and executing periodic compliance reviews.
Risk Assessment: Execute day-to-day risk assessments to determine vendor criticality and identify inherent risks in categories such as PII handling, BSA/AML, and credit decisioning.
Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Legal to ensure effective contracts are in place and with Information Security to validate the technical safeguards of our third-party partners.
Issue Escalation: Identify, track, and escalate risk events or performance failures to senior leadership and bank partners through established issue-tracking systems.


What We Look For:


Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in vendor risk management, procurement, or third-party compliance, preferably within the fintech or regulated financial services industry.
Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of third-party risk management lifecycle and regulatory guidance (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GLBA, and BSA/AML).
Execution: Proven track record of managing a high volume of vendor assessments and maintaining a state of "audit-readiness" for bank partners and regulators.
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or equivalent practical experience.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You: 


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About the job

Overview

CARRERAS PARA SONREÍR

En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día.

Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos.

Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea.

Tu impacto 

Asegurar el cumplimiento de los objetivos de volumen, distribución, participación de mercado y ejecución en punto de venta, mediante la supervisión, desarrollo y acompañamiento del equipo de vendedores, garantizando una operación eficiente, rentable y alineada a los estándares de PepsiCo.

Carrera terminada (Se pueden evaluar recien graduados).

Apasionado por las ventas. y trabajo en campo.

1 año manejando equipos. (De preferencia).

description:
About the job

Senior Customer Support Specialist (LATAM)

Location: Remote

Reports to: Director of Business Operations




About Us

We're a fast-growing startup in the wellness travel space, helping people book and get to transformative retreat experiences around the world. We're small, remote-first, and moving quickly as we scale up our support operations.




About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Senior Customer Support Specialist to work tickets, calls, and escalations alongside the rest of our Customer Support team — while also serving as the go-to person when something exceeds what a rep should handle alone.




This is a true hands-on role: the majority of your time is spent working the same volume of tickets, calls, and emails as the rest of the team, plus owning complex or escalated cases. You'll set the standard for how support should be done, mentor the team informally by example, and surface ideas and patterns to leadership — without taking on formal management or accountability for the team.

You'll work closely with the broader CS team as well as our inventory and operations functions, and escalate anything that exceeds what should be resolved at your level to the Director of Business Operations.




What You'll Do

Frontline Work

Work the same volume of tickets, calls, and emails as the rest of the CS team via HubSpot Help Desk
Own complex or escalated customer issues, including retreat-related disputes and rebooking logic
Be the first point of contact for any escalation — high-risk cancellations, VIP disputes, policy exceptions, anything beyond what a rep should resolve alone
Know when a case exceeds your own authority and escalate it to the Director of Business Operations with clear context
Step in to cover volume spikes, PTO, or gaps in team coverage
Coordinate with the inventory and operations teams on cases involving availability changes, vendor issues, or booking conflicts

Mentor (Lead by Example)

Set the standard for response quality, tone, and resolution speed — reps learn the right way by watching how you handle real tickets and calls
Spot productivity gaps and friction points across the team and bring them to the Director of Business Operations, with recommendations — not just flags
Share best practices informally — walk a rep through a tough call, show a better way to handle a tricky cancellation, model good phrasing
Flag recurring pain points to management

Systems & Reporting

Bring experience with AI-assisted support tooling (e.g., Intercom Fin AI or similar) to help evaluate and roll out automation that reduces manual ticket load
Partner with the Director of Business Operations on process improvements and SOPs




What We're Looking For

3+ years in customer support
Startup experience: comfortable with ambiguity, wears multiple hats, builds process rather than waiting for it to exist
Scrappy and systems/process-oriented — genuinely energized by fixing a broken workflow, not just running the one that's handed to you
Hands-on experience with HubSpot Help Desk or a comparable CRM/ticketing platform
Experience with Intercom Fin AI or similar AI-assisted support tools is a strong plus
Native/fluent or advanced English speaker with strong verbal communication — this role includes phone support
Experience in travel, hospitality, wellness, or a similarly relationship-driven service industry is a plus, but not required




Why This Role

Real ownership over how support gets done, during a period of real change (AI tooling, team restructuring, seasonal scaling)
Autonomy paired with a strong existing operational foundation
Fully remote, working closely with a small, high-context leadership team, plus close collaboration with CS, inventory, account management, and operations




Compensation: $35,000-45,000 USD/year, commensurate with experience.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About the job

Customer Support Specialist - Mexico




Location: Mexico City or Mérida, Mexico

 Work arrangement: Hybrid

 Employment: Full-time




About Getmee

Getmee is an Australian AI company delivering education and employability technology to help learners improve their English, communication, interview and employability skills.

Our technology is used by education, employment and workforce development organisations to provide personalized AI coaching and learning experiences at high scale. As we continue to grow our presence in Mexico and Latin America, we are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team locally.




The role

We are looking for a proactive and people-focused Customer Support Specialist based in either Mexico City or Mérida.

You will be one of the key connections between Getmee and our customers, partners and learners in Mexico. You will be responsible for making sure our customers are supported, technical issues are resolved within the agreend SLAs and learners get the best possible experience from our platform.

You will work closely with customers, understand their needs, help with onboarding and training, identify recurring issues and collaborate with our product and technical teams in Australia.

You will also play an important role in helping the team continuously improve the experience for our Spanish-speaking users.




Key responsibilities

● Provide friendly and responsive customer support in Spanish and English across email, chat, video calls and other support channels.

● Respond to customer questions, troubleshoot platform issues and ensure problems are followed through to resolution on ZenDesk.

● Support the onboarding of new customers, administrators, educators and users.

● Conduct online and face-to-face product demonstrations and training sessions when required.

● Build strong relationships with our customers and partners in Mexico.

● Monitor support requests and identify recurring issues, user feedback and opportunities for improvement.

● Escalate technical issues to Getmee's product and development teams with clear information and context.

● Follow up with customers to ensure issues have been successfully resolved.

● Create and maintain Spanish-language help resources, FAQs, guides and other customer-support materials.

● Support customer engagement, adoption and usage of the Getmee platform.

● Work closely with our Australian team across customer success, product, technology and operations.

● Provide feedback on Mexican customer and user needs to help improve our products and services.

● Assist with local customer meetings, workshops and events when required.




About you

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping people and solving problems.

You'll ideally have:

● Previous experience in customer support, customer success, SaaS, EdTech or technology support.

● Excellent written and spoken Spanish.

● Good written and spoken English.

● Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

● Confidence communicating with customers through email, chat and video calls.

● Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate issues before escalating them.

● Good technology skills and the ability to quickly learn new software platforms.

● Strong organisation and attention to detail.

● The ability to work independently while collaborating with an international team.

● A positive, customer-first mindset.

● An interest in AI, education, employability or technology.




What success looks like

You'll help us ensure that customers and users in Mexico feel supported from the moment they start working with Getmee.

 

Why join Getmee?

You'll join an Australian technology company using AI to create meaningful social and economic impact.

You'll have the opportunity to:

● Help grow Getmee's presence in Mexico and Latin America.

● Work with an international team across Australia, India and Mexico.

● Work with emerging AI technology in education and employability.

● Build relationships with universities, education organisations and workforce partners.

● Have a direct influence on how we support and grow our customers in Mexico.

● Work in a flexible hybrid environment based in Mexico City or Mérida.




We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us and help create an outstanding experience for every Getmee customer and learner in Mexico.

 

Apply here or send your resume to hi@getmee.ai

Bask is the best telehealth platform on the market. Our mission is to empower entrepreneurs and businesses to launch a DTC telemedicine company quickly and easily, abstracting away the complexities of the industry into an easy-to-use platform. With hundreds of features to meet the unique needs of telehealth, we put all the tools in our customers hands for success. We are a rapidly growing startup, and we work with care and intention to create a high-performance company with the following in mind:

Speed Wins. Make decisions, move quickly, and know that if things go wrong, it's okay for you and the company.
Intuition, Then Data. We're a data-driven company. We start with our instincts and then use data to validate our decisions and improve
Miles, Not Inches. Thinking small is a self-fulfilling prophecy. Favor bold ideas over incremental changes
Customer-Obsession. We are obsessed with helping all our customers launch multi-billion-dollar companies with ease. We accomplish this by knowing our customers incredibly well and finding ways to make their businesses better.
Ownership & Accountability, together. We embody a culture of extreme ownership, accountability, and teamwork. We count on every team member to take responsibility for their work, embrace a proactive mindset to overcome challenges, and work together to achieve our collective success


A look into the day to day:

Building logic based questionnaires (asynchronous visits) through the Bask software (if you have experience with building logic based workflows, you'll be great at this!)
Helping customers launch and upsell medications from start to to finish
Triaging bask software and order related questions and issues that come up for any of your accounts, any time of the day


We're Looking For

A self-starter who is passionate about enhancing the customer experience; you take pride in demonstrating the value of the products and services to your customers. You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You are passionate and proficient in written and spoken communications.



Customer Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.

We are looking for Customer Success people who take full ownership of their accounts, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about the patient and provider experience.

Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to draft communications, structure problems, and think through customer needs. Apply your own judgment to refine the output and make it human.

title: Event Marketing Manager | B2B & Corporate Events
description:
About the job

For our client, an international technology company that is strengthening its commercial and marketing presence in Mexico and LATAM, we are looking for Event Marketing Manager | B2B Tech Events in Mexico.




We are looking for a proactive, hands-on and highly organized Event Marketing Manager who can take ownership of event activities in Mexico, from identifying the right opportunities and managing local vendors to lead capture, CRM follow-up and post-event performance analysis.

This is not a purely operational event-planning role.




The main goal of this role is to make events a measurable commercial channel by supporting brand awareness, generating qualified leads, contributing to SQL and pipeline creation, and connecting event participation with clear business outcomes.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR IN OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

· We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of event execution in Mexico and manage multiple details, vendors, deadlines, and internal stakeholders at the same time.

· The ideal candidate should have solid experience organizing corporate, B2B marketing events and should understand that events are not only about logistis, but also about brand visibility, lead generation, CRM follow-up, and business impact.

 

EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING SECTORS WOULD BE HIGHLY VALUABLE:

B2B technology; SaaS; FinTech / PayTech; banking technology; telecom; CPaaS; cloud communications; contact center technology; enterprise software; digital B2B services; corporate event agencies serving technology or business clients. 

 

1. Experience in event management, event marketing, field marketing, corporate events, B2B events. 

2. Previous experience organizing business-focused events such as conferences, trade shows, expos, sponsored events, business lunches, executive dinners, roundtables, or partner events. 

3. Strong experience coordinating local vendors, including venues, production teams, booth builders, printing suppliers, merchandise providers, catering providers, and logistics partners. 

4. Ability to manage event timelines, budgets, materials, approvals, deadlines, and several event-related workstreams simultaneously. 

5. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through. 

6. Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. 

7. Ability to work independently, anticipate risks, and proactively follow up on open tasks. 

8. Fluent Spanish for local coordination with vendors, venues, and partners in Mexico + Strong business English for communication with the direct manager and international teams. 

9. Based in Mexico, ideally in Mexico City or nearby. 

10. Availability to travel when required for events.

 

MAIN JOB FUNCTIONS

1. Develop and regularly update the annual event calendar for Mexico and LATAM prioritizing activities based on ICP fit, brand relevance, and commercial potential. 

2. Identify and evaluate relevant conferences, summits, trade shows, business events, executive dinners, roundtables, sponsorships, and co-hosted event opportunities. 

3. Coordinate the company’s participation in events from end to end, including planning, budgeting, logistics, vendor management, booth or brand zone preparation, materials, merchandise, and onsite execution. 

4. Manage local vendors and partners in Mexico, including booth builders, production teams, venues, catering providers, printing suppliers, merchandising providers, logistics partners, and event agencies. 

5. Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, PR, and regional teams to ensure that each event is aligned with commercial priorities, target accounts, product messaging, and marketing goals. 

6. Support lead generation during events by helping the Sales team collect, organize, and qualify leads through badge scanning, forms, meetings, demos, networking activities, and other lead capture methods. 

7. Ensure proper synchronization of event leads with the company’s CRM, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems, including accurate tagging, data quality, lead ownership, and follow-up visibility. 

8. Coordinate post-event follow-up activities together with Sales, Content, and Product Marketing teams, including email campaigns, social media coverage, PR materials, presentations, and nurture flows. 

9. Support the organization of smaller high-value event formats, such as executive dinners, business lunches, partner events, roundtables, and co-branded activities. 

10. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports, analyzing KPIs such as MQLs, SQLs, CPL, conversion rate, meetings generated, pipeline contribution, ARR potential, branded traffic, media mentions, and overall ROI. 

 

Why Join This Team?

1. This is a great opportunity to join an international B2B technology company expanding in Mexico and LATAM, with a highly attractive compensation package, a mostly remote work format, and the opportunity to travel for key events and conferences.

2. You will take real ownership of event marketing activities in Mexico, working on high-impact initiatives that go beyond logistics and directly support brand visibility, qualified lead generation, pipeline contribution, and business growth.

3. The role offers strong exposure to cloud communications, CPaaS, contact center solutions, and customer engagement technologies, while collaborating with international Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and regional teams.

4. You will join a supportive, collaborative, and non-toxic environment where responsibility, initiative, learning, and ownership are valued. You will also receive guidance from an experienced manager and regional event team, while having the freedom to bring ideas, improve processes, test new event formats, and help build a stronger event marketing function in Mexico.

 

Three Keys to Success in This Position

 

 Ownership, responsibility, and strong execution discipline

 Strong local execution and vendor management in Mexico

 Business-oriented event marketing mindset

 

If you are proactive, highly organized, and excited about building impactful B2B event marketing activities in Mexico, we would be very happy to meet you. Please send your CV to this email cv@tk-recruitment.com we would love to learn more about you.

About the job

Product Marketing Analyst – Printing Solutions




📍 Ciudad de México | Santa Fe | Esquema híbrido




Sobre Brother

Brother es una compañía global de tecnología con más de 115 años de historia, reconocida por desarrollar soluciones que simplifican y enriquecen la forma en que las personas viven, trabajan y crean.




Nuestro portafolio incluye soluciones de impresión para hogar, oficina y empresas, soluciones de etiquetado e identificación, costura y manualidades, así como soluciones industriales.

Brother México inició operaciones en 1992 y forma parte de Brother International Corporation, subsidiaria de Brother Industries, Ltd., compañía global con sede en Nagoya, Japón y presencia en más de 30 países.




¿Por qué trabajar en Brother?

En Brother México creemos que las personas son fundamentales para nuestro éxito. Promovemos un ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo y flexible, donde cada persona puede contribuir, desarrollarse y generar impacto.




Nuestra cultura se guía por cuatro impulsores que definen cómo trabajamos y tomamos decisiones:

Responsabilidad | Autenticidad | Audacia | Excelencia

Bajo nuestra promesa “At your side”, buscamos estar cerca de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades, creando soluciones y experiencias que generen valor sostenible.




Sobre la posición

Buscamos un/a Product Marketing Analyst para contribuir al desarrollo de nuestra categoría de soluciones de impresión para hogar, oficina y empresas, con un enfoque particular en el canal de mayoreo y distribución.




Es una posición que combina Product Marketing, análisis comercial, estrategia de producto y trabajo cercano con Ventas, con exposición a clientes, distribuidores y equipos internacionales.




Tu principal objetivo




Impulsar el desarrollo de la categoría de impresión en México mediante estrategias de producto y marketing que contribuyan al crecimiento de Sell In y Sell Out, rentabilidad, participación de mercado, penetración del portafolio y desarrollo de canales.

Buscamos a una persona capaz de analizar el negocio de punta a punta —producto, precio, inventario, competencia, canales y resultados— y convertir esos insights en acciones comerciales concretas.




¿Qué harás?

📊 Product & Business Analysis

Analizar el desempeño de la categoría considerando Sell In, Sell Out, inventario, forecast, crecimiento y mix de producto, identificando oportunidades y riesgos.

Analizar el desempeño de productos, iniciativas comerciales y acciones de marketing, proponiendo planes de mejora.
Generar análisis de GP, rentabilidad y ROI por producto, iniciativa y canal.
Identificar oportunidades para incrementar participación de mercado, rentabilidad y penetración del portafolio.




🚀 Product & Go-to-Market Strategy

Participar en el desarrollo de estrategias de lanzamiento, posicionamiento y crecimiento de productos.
Desarrollar propuestas de valor y argumentos comerciales para las diferentes soluciones de impresión.

Brindar soporte de producto y marketing a los equipos de Ventas.

Administrar y dar seguimiento al presupuesto de marketing de la categoría.

Monitorear el impacto financiero de las iniciativas de producto y marketing.

¿Qué buscamos?

Licenciatura concluida en Marketing, Administración, Negocios, Ingeniería Comercial o áreas afines.
Experiencia en Product Marketing, Category Management, Trade Marketing, Marketing Comercial, Business Analysis o posiciones relacionadas.

Experiencia trabajando en compañías multinacionales o estructuras matriciales.
Experiencia colaborando con equipos regionales o globales.




Las competencias que buscamos

Buscamos una persona analítica y con visión de negocio, capaz de entender qué está detrás de los números y convertir información en acciones.

Alguien proactivo y curioso, que quiera conocer el producto, el mercado, los clientes y la competencia para identificar nuevas oportunidades.

Una persona orientada a resultados, que pueda conectar las estrategias de marketing con resultados comerciales concretos.




Un perfil colaborativo, capaz de construir relaciones efectivas con Ventas, Marketing Digital, Finanzas, clientes, distribuidores y equipos internacionales.

Y, especialmente, alguien que viva nuestros impulsores culturales: Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia.




Lo que encontrarás en Brother

Ofrecemos una propuesta integral orientada al bienestar, desarrollo y experiencia de nuestros colaboradores, que incluye:

Esquema híbrido de trabajo.
Seguros médico, dental y de vida.
Programa de ahorro.

Beneficios y permisos enfocados en momentos importantes de la vida personal y familiar.
Programas de capacitación y desarrollo profesional.
Recursos de aprendizaje autodirigido.
Código de vestimenta casual.
Estacionamiento en nuestras oficinas de Santa Fe.




Nuestro entorno de trabajo

La oficina corporativa de Brother México se encuentra en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México, donde se concentran diversas funciones de nuestro negocio.

Nuestro edificio cuenta con una pre-certificación nivel Platino, reflejando nuestro compromiso con un entorno de trabajo moderno y con la responsabilidad social.




Nuestra cultura




Nuestra misión es cumplir nuestra promesa “At your side”, simplificando y enriqueciendo la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades.

Aspiramos a estar donde las personas y la tecnología se encuentran, ofreciendo productos y soluciones que mejoren la manera en que las personas viven, trabajan y crean.




Nuestros impulsores culturales — Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia — orientan la forma en que colaboramos, tomamos decisiones y construimos el futuro de Brother.

Igualdad de oportunidades

Brother es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con construir un entorno inclusivo y respetuoso para todas las personas.




Damos la bienvenida a candidatos de todos los orígenes y no discriminamos por motivos de raza, género, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual ni por cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación aplicable




¿Te interesa combinar producto, análisis y estrategia comercial para desarrollar una categoría?

Queremos conocerte. Postúlate y sé parte del futuro de Brother México.

Driven by innovation, purpose, and a commitment to improving lives, we are expanding our portfolio of solutions to serve even more patients, healthcare providers, and communities around the world.

Why embecta?

Imagine the long legacy and global scale of an industry leader combined with the agility, speed, and entrepreneurial energy of a startup—that's embecta. We are evolving from a company with more than 100 years of experience in diabetes care into a broader medical supplies organization, helping more than 30 million people worldwide live their best lives through innovative solutions, partnerships, and the strength of our global team. At embecta, you are empowered to take ownership, bring your authentic self to work, and accelerate your career alongside inspiring leaders.

Analyzes the Mexican market, customers, competitors, channels, pricing, pack architecture, and unmet needs to identify growth opportunities and business risks.
