description:
About the job

Join a team that puts people at the center of everything.




At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it’s about connecting humans with humans. We’re a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career with a leading US-based company—fully remote.




You’ll join a woman-owned, small-batch natural skincare brand handmade in Florida — tallow, goat milk and castor-oil-based products sold direct-to-consumer through Shopify, plus one physical storefront. The brand already runs an active, growing TikTok Shop affiliate program alongside a strong organic presence on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.




This is a role for someone who can take ownership of the channel — not simply coordinate creators. It’s an individual contributor position, and the expectation is real ownership of outcomes, not only task execution.




You won’t be starting from zero. Per-platform affiliate infrastructure and commission structures already exist, and there are 100+ affiliates in the program today. But the program has outgrown what’s currently being managed, and this hire is expected to build the systems, relationships and judgment needed to run it at scale.




What You'll Do

Recruit and onboard TikTok affiliates and UGC creators — including filtering serious applicants from spam and low-quality inbound.
Build and maintain creator relationships: proactively reach out to new creators who’d be a strong fit, while managing and growing the existing 100+ affiliate network.
Manage product seeding and outreach.
Develop affiliate campaigns, incentives and commission strategies — evolving and running the structures that already exist across platforms, not building them from scratch.
Secure high-quality UGC that can also be used in paid advertising, through affiliate follow-up and account management, making sure agreed content actually gets posted. This role does not create the content itself.
Track creator performance and grow the channel based on results.
Establish the systems and processes needed to scale: the per-platform affiliate structures exist, but the workflows to triage and manage 100+ (and growing) affiliate relationships day to day still need to be built.
Handle day-to-day affiliate communication — answering questions on commissions, products and program requirements over email and DM.




What You Bring

Proven experience in affiliate or influencer marketing. This one is required, no exceptions.
Fluent, confident English communication skills, and comfort negotiating and building relationships with U.S.-based creators.
Strong familiarity with the TikTok platform and the creator/affiliate ecosystem.
An outgoing, personable communication style — you’ll be the primary point of contact for dozens of creators every day.




Nice to Have

Experience with Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform.
Personal engagement with beauty, skincare or wellness content and communities.




Salary & Perks

Competitive Pay: We hire top talent and compensate accordingly.
This is a full-time, long-term engagement with room to grow.
An individual contributor role with real ownership of the channel.
The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with TLNT.
100% remote — work from wherever you do your best thinking.
Additional perks.




Ready to apply?

We’d love to hear your story. The next step is a short application where you can share more about your background and upload your resume in English. Take your time — we read every response carefully.

If you like innovation, digital commerce and want to contribute to Bacardi’s growth in Mexico with our amazing global brands, this is the right role for you.

You will support the development and execution of the Mexico eCommerce plan for key national customers with online activity and pure players, coordinating initiatives, tracking performance and identifying opportunities to drive revenue growth while strengthening brand visibility and desire in the digital ecosystem.

Fluency in Spanish and English, written and verbal.
